nodes.title: SG-6.4.4 · A 401 from Approve, Retry or Reject returns to the token gate
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/components/AdminApp.tsx already routes a 401 from runExecutionAction into handleError, which clears the token and sets gateError 'Invalid token'. Only the approve 401 path is tested, and handleError leaves earlier error and action-error state behind. Desired behavior: Approve, Retry and Reject each return to the token gate on 401, with no stale action error. Why: the admin must never see leftover errors or data after re-entering a token.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an authenticated admin, when approve, retry or reject returns 401, then the Admin token field is shown with 'Invalid token'.
- Given an earlier action error is displayed, when a later 401 occurs and the token is re-entered, then the old action error is not shown.


## Scope
- In scope: AdminApp handleError 401 branch
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: New UI components
- Preserve: Existing load-path 401 behavior
- Preserve: Non-401 action errors shown through actionError


## Technical constraints
- UI-only change
- Token stays in memory only


## Definition of done
- All three actions verified by unit tests


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Approve, Retry and Reject 401 clear the token and show the gate with no stale action error
nodes.body:
runExecutionAction already delegates a 401 to handleError. handleError must also clear actionError and actionDetail so no earlier action failure survives the return to the gate.

- Given approve, retry or reject returns 401, when the response arrives, then the token gate shows 'Invalid token'.
- Given actionError was set by a prior 500, when a 401 follows, then actionError and actionDetail are cleared.

- Out of scope: Backend
- Preserve: Non-401 error display


## Technical constraints

nodes.title: REQ · After a 401 and re-entry, AdminApp shows no stale round or execution data
nodes.body:
After the gate returns, a re-entered token must show the Loading round state rather than the previous round, execution and contribution list, so stale Approve, Retry or Reject buttons cannot appear.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a 401 from an execution action, when the gate is shown, then no Round or Execution content is rendered.
- Given the token is re-entered, when data reloads, then the loaded round and execution come from the new responses.


## Scope
- In scope: handleError 401 branch in AdminApp.tsx
- Out of scope: Backend
- Preserve: Existing reload flow via reloads counter


## Technical constraints
- Reset state with the existing setters setRound, setExecution and setContributions


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- 401 branch resets round, execution and contributions


## Clarifying questions
- None
